$description: HAM core design tokens (v1.3). Source of truth for HAM's own system: neutrals, semantic colors, status tones, type scale, spacing, motion. Identical for every church. Brand-layer slots (primitive.color.brand, primitive.color.accent, font.family.display/ui and the {brand.*} roles) are filled at build time from brands/<brand>/brand.json by `python3 design-system/tools/build_tokens.py --brand <brand> --check`. Semantic tokens: $value = light theme; $extensions['ham.modes'].dark = dark theme, kept for later (V1 is light only, Q-016; dark applies only via data-theme="dark"). Icons are Lucide names.

ham.brandPolicy.$description: What a church brand may customize. Everything else in this file is HAM's core system and is identical for every church. Read by tools/build_tokens.py; see brands/README.md.

Roboto Condensed.note: Condensed, calmer than Oswald; Latin Extended + Cyrillic.

Montserrat.note: Wide geometric; for churches whose wordmark is geometric rather than condensed.

Inter.note: No separate display face: headings use the UI face.
HAM default. Large x-height, tabular figures.

brand.$description: Brand layer. Filled at build time by tools/build_tokens.py from the church's seed color in brands/<brand>/brand.json (steps 50-950, 500 = seed). Do not add values here.

accent.$description: Brand layer. The church's brand colors sorted lightest to darkest, filled at build time. DECORATIVE ONLY: never text, never the only indicator of state.

green.$description: HAM's own fixed green for the 'active' status tone. Part of the core system: identical for every church, never taken from the brand.

display.$description: Brand layer: the church's display face (approved list in $extensions.ham.brandPolicy). Sparse use: screen titles (h1), KPI numbers, requester page hero. Never body, labels or buttons.

ui.$description: Brand layer: the church's UI face (approved list in $extensions.ham.brandPolicy). All UI text.

display.$description: Desktop screen title / requester hero. Mobile uses h1.

body-lg.$description: Default body on requester-facing pages and long reading.

body.$description: Default body. Minimum size for body text.

small.$description: Metadata only (timestamps, helper text). Absolute minimum size.

nav-compact.$description: Bottom-nav label ONLY (icon carries meaning, label paired). 12px exception, 5 items max.

code-entry.$description: 6-digit code field and the request number on confirmation screens. Use tabular-nums + ss02 (I/l/1, 0/O distinct).

target-min.$description: Minimum touch/click target (matches docs/ux; exceeds WCAG 2.5.8; field use with gloves).

control-sm.$description: Dense desktop tables only; hit area still padded to target-min.

control-lg.$description: Primary action on mobile field screens, requester pages.

logo-min-height.$description: Full lockup, on screen. Below this use logo-mark.

chip.$description: Status chip height in the signed-in app (components.md §5).

chip-lg.$description: Status chip height on requester pages (components.md §5).

choice-card-min.$description: Minimum height of a radio/checkbox choice card (components.md §19). Grows with text; never clips at 200% zoom.

code-input-max.$description: Max width of the 6-digit code field (components.md §20). rem so it grows with the user's font setting.

dropzone-height.$description: Requester upload drop zone min height, desktop only (patterns.md §8).

progress-height.$description: Progress bars: wizard step bar, staffing bar, per-file upload bar. Always paired with text.

accent-bar.$description: Left tone/selection bar on attention cards, selected list rows and sidebar items.

modal-sm.$description: Desktop modal / sheet width, short forms (components.md §14).

modal-md.$description: Desktop modal / sheet width, longer content such as the phone-check sheet.

split-list.$description: List pane width in the >=1280 split view (patterns.md §2).

step-rail.$description: Desktop wizard step list width (patterns.md §5, components.md §21).

aside.$description: Desktop help / side panel width (wizard 'Good to know', requester R1 read-ahead).

wizard-max.$description: Desktop wizard container: step-rail + form-max + aside + 2 x space-8 gaps.

icon-xl.$description: Hero / result icons (success check on R7, R7N; expired and not-available pages). Decorative.

list-row-min.$description: Minimum height of a two- or three-line list row (request rows, components.md §28).

requester-wide-max.$description: Secure request page two-column container at >=1280 (intake R10).

short.$description: Viewport HEIGHT below which sticky bottom action bars become static (landscape phones, large text). Use as (max-height: 480px).

surface-raised.$description: Menus, modals (dark: lighter to show elevation).

appbar.$description: App bar is dark in BOTH themes so the official white logo is used.

disabled.$description: WCAG-exempt; always pair with not-allowed state explanation where needed.

field-bg.$description: Search field inside the always-dark app bar.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text/placeholder on the app bar.

status-ok.$description: Integration-OK dot/icon on the app bar.

bg.$description: Count badge (nav, bell). Same in both themes so white text stays >=4.5:1.

ring.$description: 3px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

info.$description: Moving through the pipeline; nothing needed from you.

attention.$description: Waiting on a person / needs action soon (warning).

active.$description: Work is on track or happening now. HAM's fixed green (primitive.color.green), not the church brand color, so status meaning is the same for every church.

success.$description: Done / verified. Teal, deliberately distinct from brand green.

danger.$description: Blocked, unsafe, expired or failed; needs action now.

ai.$description: AI suggestion or draft only. Never used for statuses.

bar-top.$description: Sticky bottom action bar, only while content scrolls beneath it (with border.default top).

commitment.$description: PRD §29, §32, §33 (names PRD-GAP Q-017 except Pending Confirmation)

commitment-flag.$description: PRD §33 — a flag + reason on a cancellation/no-show, NOT a status (PRD-GAP Q-022)

credential-expiry.$description: PRD §24.1 — computed from the expiration date; badges, NOT statuses (PRD-GAP Q-018)
